summary: Test suite covers main script functionality (classification, report building, formatters, CLI) with clear organization by feature. However, significant gaps: (1) many error conditions implemented in code (invalid JSON, missing fields, invalid rotation_days/warning_days, non-list secrets) are untested; (2) CLI argument validation (invalid --format, --today) not tested; (3) edge cases like empty secrets array, exact zero days remaining, config overrides not tested; (4) fixture files referenced but content not shown, preventing fixture quality assessment; (5) critical task requirement—act-based workflow execution verification and act-result.txt artifact—is absent; test_workflow_structure.py only validates YAML structure and actionlint, not actual workflow execution. Would catch regressions in happy paths but miss error handling and edge case breaks.
